# Discussion Guidelines

Welcome to the waporta community discussions! This is the place to ask questions, share ideas, and connect with other users and contributors.

---

## Categories

### Q&A
> **Ask anything about setting up or using waporta.**

Examples:
- How do I configure multiple sessions?
- Why is my QR code not appearing?
- Can I run waporta without Docker?

### Ideas
> **Suggest features or improvements.**

Before posting, search existing discussions to avoid duplicates. Describe:
- What you want to achieve
- Why the current behavior doesn't cover it
- Any implementation ideas you have (optional)

### Show and Tell
> **Share what you built with waporta.**

Integrations, automation scripts, use cases — share them here. Include a short description and, if possible, a code snippet or screenshot.

### General
> **Anything that doesn't fit the above categories.**

---

## Before You Post

1. **Search first** — your question may already be answered.
2. **Be specific** — vague questions get vague answers.
3. **Include context** — Node.js version, OS, Docker version, and relevant logs help a lot.
4. **Use code blocks** — wrap code and logs in triple backticks (` ``` `).

---

## Bug Reports

Discussions are not the right place for bug reports. If you've found a bug, please [open an issue](https://github.com/iniadil/waporta/issues) instead.

---

## Code of Conduct

- Be respectful and constructive.
- No spam, self-promotion, or off-topic content.
- Help others when you can — this is a community.

---
